name: Podmarchy
author: Gran Software Solutions
description: Podcast player for the Omarchy shell. Search Podcast Index or browse trending shows, subscribe, and stream episodes through mpv that resume where you stopped. Playback survives closing the panel, media keys work via MPRIS, and a bar widget shows what's playing. Needs a free Podcast Index API key and secret.

barWidget.description: Click to open Podmarchy. Right-click pauses or resumes, scroll seeks.
